mapper.select: select id from s_operation where account_id=#{account} and session_id=#{session} and turn_id=#{turn} and ordinal=#{ordinal} and operation_type='TTS' and status='RUNNING' and tts_reservation_known=true for update
select from s_voice_task where id=#{id} for update
select from s_voice_task where account_id=#{account} and purpose=#{purpose} and source_key=#{source} for update
select from s_voice_attempt where id=#{id} for update
select concat(coalesce(o.settlement_outcome,'NONE'),':',o.settlement_status) from s_voice_task t join s_operation o on o.id=t.operation_id where t.id=#{task}
select from s_voice_attempt where task_id=#{task} order by attempt_no desc limit 1
select from s_voice_attempt where task_id=#{task} order by attempt_no
mapper.update: update s_voice_attempt a join s_voice_task t on t.id=a.task_id left join s_operation o on o.id=t.operation_id left join s_session s on s.id=t.session_id set a.state='DISPATCHING',a.worker_instance_id=#{worker},a.worker_boot_id=#{boot},a.dispatched_at=utc_timestamp(3) where a.id=#{id} and a.dispatch_token_hash=#{hash} and a.state in ('CREATED','QUEUED') and t.revision=#{revision} and t.status in ('QUEUED','RUNNING') and t.winner_attempt_id is null and t.cancel_requested_at is null and t.deadline_at > utc_timestamp(3) and (t.purpose='AUDITION' or (o.account_id=t.account_id and o.session_id=t.session_id and o.turn_id=t.turn_id and o.status='RUNNING' and o.tts_reservation_known=true and o.settlement_status='NONE' and s.status='ACTIVE' and s.expires_at > utc_timestamp(3) and s.active_turn_id=t.turn_id and s.connection_epoch=t.connection_epoch))

update s_operation o join s_voice_task t on t.operation_id=o.id set o.tts_dispatch_state='DISPATCHING' where t.id=#{task} and o.account_id=t.account_id and o.tts_dispatch_state='PREPARED' and o.settlement_status='NONE'
update s_voice_task set status='RUNNING',updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where id=#{id} and status='QUEUED'
mapper.select: select payload_hash from s_voice_event where attempt_id=#{attempt} and event_id=#{event}
mapper.insert: insert into s_outbox(id,created_at,updated_at,account_id,event_id,event_type,aggregate_type,aggregate_id,schema_version,trace_id,payload,status,attempt_count,next_run_at) select uuid_short(),utc_timestamp(3),utc_timestamp(3),t.account_id,sha2(concat('voice-attempt:',a.id,':',#{event}),256),'VOICE_ATTEMPT_FACT','VOICE_ATTEMPT',cast(a.id as char),1,sha2(#{event},256), json_object('eventId',sha2(concat('voice-attempt:',a.id,':',#{event}),256),'accountId',t.account_id,'taskId',t.id,'attemptId',a.id,'purpose',t.purpose, 'applicationId',s.application_id,'sessionId',t.session_id,'turnId',t.turn_id,'logicalOperationKey',if(t.purpose='BUSINESS',concat('tts:',t.turn_id,':',json_unquote(json_extract(o.result_summary,'$.segmentId'))),null), 'serviceId',a.service_id,'providerType',a.provider_type,'modelId',json_unquote(json_extract(t.binding_snapshot,if(a.attempt_no=1,'$.modelId','$.fallback.modelId'))), 'status',a.state,'providerRequestId',a.provider_request_id,'costSource',a.cost_source,'errorCode',a.error_code),'PENDING',0,utc_timestamp(3) from s_voice_attempt a join s_voice_task t on t.id=a.task_id left join s_session s on s.id=t.session_id left join s_operation o on o.id=t.operation_id where a.id=#{attempt}
mapper.update: update s_voice_attempt set state=#{state},error_code=#{code},failure_stage=#{stage},result_summary=cast(#{summary} as json),provider_request_id=#{providerRequest},cost_source=#{cost},query_next_at=utc_timestamp(3),finished_at=utc_timestamp(3),updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where id=#{id} and state in ('CREATED','QUEUED','DISPATCHING','ACCEPTED','UNKNOWN')

update s_voice_task t join s_voice_attempt a on a.task_id=t.id and a.id=#{attempt} set t.winner_attempt_id=a.id,t.status='SUCCEEDED',t.result_reference=cast(#{result} as json),t.error_code=null,t.finished_at=utc_timestamp(3),t.updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where t.id=#{task} and t.winner_attempt_id is null and a.state='SUCCEEDED' and a.attempt_no=t.revision and t.status in ('QUEUED','RUNNING','UNKNOWN','CANCELLED')

update s_voice_task set status=#{state},error_code=#{code},finished_at=utc_timestamp(3),updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where id=#{task} and winner_attempt_id is null and status in ('QUEUED','RUNNING','UNKNOWN')

update s_voice_task t set revision=2,status='QUEUED',updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where id=#{task} and revision=1 and winner_attempt_id is null and cancel_requested_at is null and deadline_at > utc_timestamp(3) and exists(select 1 from s_voice_attempt a where a.task_id=#{task} and a.attempt_no=1 and a.state='FAILED') and (purpose='AUDITION' or exists(select 1 from s_session s where s.id=t.session_id and s.status='ACTIVE' and s.active_turn_id=t.turn_id and s.connection_epoch=t.connection_epoch))

update s_operation o join s_voice_task t on t.operation_id=o.id set o.tts_dispatch_state=if(#{outcome}='SETTLE','SUCCEEDED','FAILED'),o.settlement_outcome=#{outcome},o.settlement_status='PENDING',o.settlement_next_at=utc_timestamp(3),o.settlement_attempts=0,o.settlement_error=null where t.id=#{task} and o.account_id=t.account_id and o.session_id=t.session_id and (o.settlement_outcome is null or o.settlement_outcome='REVIEW') and o.tts_dispatch_state!='SUCCEEDED'
mapper.select: select count(*) from s_outbox x join s_voice_attempt a on cast(a.id as char character set utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_0900_as_cs=x.aggregate_id where a.task_id=#{task} and x.event_type='VOICE_ATTEMPT_FACT' and x.status!='SENT' and x.attempt_count>=12
select from s_voice_attempt where state='UNKNOWN' and query_count < 12 and query_next_at <= utc_timestamp(3) order by query_next_at,id limit 4
mapper.update: update s_voice_attempt set query_count=query_count+1,query_next_at=date_add(utc_timestamp(3),interval 30 second) where id=#{id} and state='UNKNOWN' and query_count < 12 and query_next_at <= utc_timestamp(3)
mapper.select: select from s_voice_task t where status in ('QUEUED','RUNNING') and (owner!=#{owner} or deadline_at <= utc_timestamp(3) or (purpose='BUSINESS' and not exists(select 1 from s_session s where s.id=t.session_id and s.active_turn_id=t.turn_id and s.status='ACTIVE' and s.connection_epoch=t.connection_epoch))) order by deadline_at,id limit 32
select from s_voice_task account_id=#{account} order by created_at desc,id desc limit 100
select from s_voice_task order by created_at desc,id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
